title: Roamhaven Rewards Credit Expiry: Inactivity Period and Notice
content:
On every Roamhaven Rewards tier the whole credit balance expires after 18 calendar months without activity, and the member is notified 30 calendar days before the expiry.

| Tier | Inactivity period before the balance expires | What counts as activity | Notice before expiry |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 18 calendar months | A completed stay or a credit redemption | 30 calendar days |
| Rewards Silver | 18 calendar months | A completed stay or a credit redemption | 30 calendar days |
| Rewards Gold | 18 calendar months | A completed stay or a credit redemption | 30 calendar days |
| Rewards Platinum | 18 calendar months | A completed stay or a credit redemption | 30 calendar days |
| Rewards Diamond | 18 calendar months | A completed stay or a credit redemption | 30 calendar days |
| Rewards Ambassador | 18 calendar months | A completed stay or a credit redemption | 30 calendar days |

## On the statement

- The figures do not differ by tier: a Rewards Ambassador balance and a Rewards Member balance are subject to the same 18-month inactivity period and the same 30-day notice.
- The inactivity period is counted in calendar months; the notice is counted in calendar days.
- On inactivity it is the whole balance that expires.
